title: celtis triflora
intro: Celtis triflora, commonly known as the Desert Hackberry, is a plant species that belongs to the Ulmaceae family. The Desert Hackberry is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to reduce fever, alleviate diarrhea, and treat skin conditions due to its health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Celtis triflora include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
